sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, PCAsteroid is a game about navigating a spaceship through a field of asteroids. Players must collect coins while avoiding obstacles and outmaneuvering opponents. The game's controls are simple yet intuitive, making it easy to pick up and play. Players can use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move their ship and collect coins.


One of the key mechanics in PCAsteroid is the ship's movement speed and agility. Players can collect power-ups to increase their ship's speed and agility, making it easier to navigate through the asteroid field and collect coins. However, players must also be careful not to get too close to the asteroids, as this can result in a game over.


Another important mechanic in PCAsteroid is the coins. Players must collect as many coins as possible to earn points and move up the leaderboard. The coins are scattered throughout the asteroid field, and players must use their skills and strategy to collect as many as possible.
